rules.statement: Agent instructions, scripts and workflows that open pull requests must create them as drafts and must not mark them ready for review or enable auto-merge; only the human author does those after reviewing.
rules.why: GitHub checks the required review-thread resolution only when a pull request enters the merge queue, so opening ready with auto-merge let a pull request merge over an unresolved review comment.
rules.check: Look for `gh pr create` without `--draft`, `gh pr ready`, `gh pr merge --auto`, or equivalent API calls in agent push protocols, scripts or workflows that run on the agent's behalf.
